meta.title: Finding Gold — Magnetic surveys
meta.author: Ezekiel Minja
meta.description: Finding Gold: a field guide to mineral exploration. Educational — not a design standard.

shape.text: a magnetic map is a geology map

the anomaly sits BESIDE its source
read the fabric, then what breaks it

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Most exploration targets never reach the surface. Geophysics is how you map rock through the ground that covers it.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Start with magnetics. It is the cheapest, the fastest and the most used tool in hard-rock exploration.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: The Earth has a magnetic field, and rocks containing magnetite distort it — locally, and measurably. Measure the total field along closely spaced lines and you are mapping magnetite.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Banded iron formation screams. Basalt and dolerite are strongly magnetic. Granite is moderate. Sedimentary rock is nearly blank. So a magnetic map is a geological map of ground you cannot see.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Then the part that matters for gold.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Hydrothermal fluid destroys magnetite, turning it into pyrite and carbonate. So an altered, mineralised shear zone often shows up as a narrow magnetic low, cutting across the magnetic rocks around it.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: You are not seeing the gold. You are seeing the plumbing. And it cuts both ways — some systems build magnetite instead, and read as highs. Which it is, you establish in each district, by drilling.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: How it is flown decides what you can see.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Line spacing sets resolution. You cannot resolve a feature narrower than about half your line spacing. So regional work flies four hundred metres, and detail work flies fifty.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Low flying is sharp and dangerous. High flying is smooth and blind. And lines go across the strike. Never along it.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Raw total field is then processed to be readable. Reduction to the pole moves each anomaly back over its source. The analytic signal puts the peak on the edge of the body.

dialogue.speaker: juma
dialogue.text: And you read structure straight off that?

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: You read the fabric. Then you read what interrupts it.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Where the fabric bends, breaks or steps sideways, there is a fault. Mark every break and every offset, and you have the structural map the soil never gave you.
